sourceScope: No exact owned title/author edition was found after checking 218 Apple Books metadata candidates, including expanded and ZIP EPUBs. No film/sequel facts or unsupported missing scenes were added. This supports independent checking of the retained sequence, not whole-book fidelity certification.
